resources.string: Lock the apps you don\'t want touched.
Finish setup to start protecting apps
Lets Locky draw the PIN screen straight on top of the app you open, so there is no transition and no glimpse of the app first. Without it, Locky falls back to a normal screen.
Device admin stops Locky from being removed, so the lock can\'t be bypassed. Locky never changes your lock screen, passwords, or data.
Android has no public API for detecting which app opens. The accessibility service does exactly that and nothing else.
A 4–8 digit PIN unlocks your protected apps. Locky stores only a salted PBKDF2 hash, never the PIN itself.
Locky cannot see which apps you open until its service is switched on. Android turns it off every time Locky is updated or reinstalled, so this needs doing once after each install.

The Locky service is switched on in Settings, but Android has not actually started it. This is a state Android sometimes gets into after an update, and it means nothing is being locked — the switch being on is not enough on its own.
In Settings, open Accessibility, then Installed services, and switch on “%1$s”. It is not listed under the name “Locky”.
In Settings, open Accessibility, then Installed services, find “%1$s”, turn it off, wait a moment, then turn it back on. That is what makes Android start it.
The Locky service is running, but no apps are marked as protected. Scroll down to the app list and switch on any app you want locked.
The Locky service is running but hit an error, so it cannot lock anything yet. Reopen the app; if it keeps happening, reinstall Locky.
Set up a screen lock on this device to unlock with biometrics.
The unlock prompt could not be shown. Use your PIN instead.
Apps switched on in this list
These two show the PIN screen without opening an app, so they test the lock itself rather than app detection.
The watcher service is not running, so there is no lock window to show. Switch it on in Settings.
Search above and switch on any app to require the PIN before it opens.
Could not read the list of installed apps. %1$s
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$s.
Device admin is required before Locky can lock apps.
Locky works entirely on your device. It has no network permission, collects nothing, and sends nothing anywhere.
Watches which app moves to the foreground and shows the Locky PIN screen when that app is one you protected. Nothing is read, typed, or sent anywhere.
Lets Locky stop itself from being uninstalled while its lock is enabled. Locky cannot read your data, change your settings, or lock your device.
